| Table 6-1. Warning Messages   | Table 6-1. Warning Messages                                                                                                             | Table 6-1. Warning Messages               |
|-------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------|
| Message                       | Possible Cause                                                                                                                          | Corrective Action                         |
| Stop delivery, then turn off  | Attempting to turn off the infuser while a delivery is in progress                                                                      | Stop all lines, then turn off the infuser |
| Warning: Low Battery          | Battery is discharged so that only approximately 30 minutes of battery life remains                                                     | Plug into AC power                        |
| Warning: Replace Battery      | Battery service needed Battery voltage is less than the depleted threshold and the charge level is higher than the low charge threshold | Replace the battery                       |
| Warning: Charger Service      | A hardware problem with the battery charging circuit is detected Charging circuitry is not behaving as expected                         | Press the SILENCE key                     |
